chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Indeed, women are dependence and vulnerability; so conceal the vulnerability with houses, and conceal the dependence with silence.

key_terms.عَوْرَةٌ: vulnerability or that which is to be concealed and protected
key_terms.عِيٌّ: dependence or lack of self-sufficiency in this context

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "إِنَّمَا النِّسَاءُ عِيٌّ وَ عَوْرَةٌ" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a concise ethical instruction concerning women in the context of conduct and social dealings. It emphasizes protection, concealment, and restraint in speech as guiding principles in this context.
